title: EGI Node - EGI
main_text: EGI for EOSC EGI Node Operated by the EGI Foundation on behalf of the EGI Federation, the Node provides scalable compute, storage, data management and advanced digital research services for data-intensive science. It delivers EOSC Core and Federating Capabilities including AAI, catalogue, monitoring, accounting, helpdesk and application deployment management, while supporting multi-node use cases in reproducible workflows, AI, sensitive data analysis, machine learning and federated LLM services. EGI for EOSC Objectives Impact Status Access the EGI Node Capabilities Coordination Key Objective in Capacity as a Node To act as a Node for data-intensive computing and large-scale research data exploitation, enabling seamless, cross-border access to FAIR data, advanced analytics, AI/ML models, compute, storage, workflow and federating capabilities for EOSC. Impact Science Areas The EGI Node is multidisciplinary, operating in the following areas: Data-intensive science Cloud computing High-throughput computing High-performance computing Artificial Intelligence and machine learning Cross-disciplinary research Scientific Impact EGI enables large-scale interdisciplinary data exploitation by combining compute, storage, workflows, data services, AI/ML models and EOSC federating capabilities across a distributed European infrastructure. Use Cases Reproducible workflows AI validation on sensitive health data Cross-node machine learning pipelines Federated LLM services Large-scale cross-node data processing FAIR Data Scientific datasets accessible through EGI DataHub and integrated NGI/RI resources. Domain data services such as EODC Data Catalog, HAL, Recherche Data Gouv, FAIDare API, WeNMR, DATAlife, yProvStore and PITHIA e-Science. FAIR-enabling services for data access, transfer, storage, provenance and reuse. Status The EGI Node currently has the status of Candidate Node. Technical status Federated AAI Onboarded service catalogues (EGI catalogue; NGI and RI service resources) Application workflow management Service monitoring Service and research product accounting Order management Helpdesk Management system Timeline and milestones Phased deployment roadmap for 2026-2027, with use cases expanded through EOSC Mesh and ongoing operation of EOSC federating capabilities. Deliverables Project charter Integration with Federating Capabilities: AAI and Catalogue Application Deployment Management API – Software Release Report: Use cases – Lessons learnt and next steps Integration with Federating Capabilities: Helpdesk, Monitoring, SMS Stakeholders and communities’ engagement strategy EOSC Mesh Cross-Node use case analysis and implementation plan How to access the node Services are offered to European researchers under EGI Access Policy or service-specific access policies, including open, quota-based, project-based or cost access depending on service.
